name: Bell Run

location.description: Market Bell to Oldroad Gate and back

steps.name: Receive Message Satchel
steps.description: Receive a message satchel from the Market Bell keeper

steps.name: Run the Route
steps.description: Carry the message to one of three district signposts

steps.name: Ring the Bell
steps.description: Ring the small bell at the destination signpost

steps.name: Return to Market Bell
steps.description: Return before the message expires

loopDescription: The player carries a message from the Market Bell to a district signpost, rings a bell, and returns before the message expires.
failureState: If the player does not return before the message expires, the satchel disappears and the run fails. No penalty beyond lost time.

name: Soot Sweep

steps.name: Sweep Soot Pile
steps.description: Sweep a soot pile from the Sootcellar floor

steps.name: Clear Grave Mites
steps.description: Fight or flee Grave Mites that emerge from the soot

loopDescription: The player sweeps soot piles from the Sootcellar floor, clearing paths and reducing Grave Mite spawn chances.
failureState: If overwhelmed by Grave Mites, the player is forced to retreat. No death penalty, but the sweep is incomplete.

name: Ledger Sort

steps.name: Receive Ledger Pages
steps.description: Receive a bundle of damaged ledger pages from the clerk

steps.name: Sort Ledger Pages
steps.description: Sort damaged ledger pages into correct piles

steps.name: Submit Bundle
steps.description: Shoo away rats and submit the correct bundles to the clerk

loopDescription: The player receives damaged ledger pages, sorts them into correct piles, then shooes away rats and submits the bundles to the clerk.
failureState: If the rats scatter the sorted piles or the pages are mis-sorted, the bundle is rejected. No penalty beyond lost time.

name: Market Rush

steps.name: Gather Basket
steps.description: Collect a market basket and fresh ingredients

steps.name: Rush Delivery
steps.description: Carry the basket to Market Bell before the ingredients spoil

steps.name: Sort and Deliver
steps.description: Sort the ingredients and deliver them to the correct vendors

loopDescription: The player gathers a basket of fresh ingredients, rushes them to Market Bell before they spoil, and sorts them for the correct vendors.
failureState: If the ingredients spoil during the rush, the basket is discarded and the delivery fails.

name: Graveflower Round

steps.name: Plant and Water Grave Flowers
steps.description: Plant grave flower seeds in a patch and water them

steps.name: Light Candles and Offer Bone Chips
steps.description: Prune overgrowth, light candles, and scatter bone chips

steps.name: Clear Grave Mites
steps.description: Clear occasional Grave Mites that infest the flower beds

loopDescription: The player tends a circuit of grave flower patches, planting and watering seeds, lighting candles, offering bone chips, and clearing occasional Grave Mites.
failureState: If the player fails to clear Grave Mites, the patch is infested and the flowers wilt. They must be replanted on the next round.

name: Foundry Shift

steps.name: Deliver Ore and Sort Blackcoal
steps.description: Haul copper and tin ore to the furnace and sort blackcoal

steps.name: Smelt Timed Batch
steps.description: Feed the furnace and smelt a timed batch of bronze

steps.name: Hammer Flawed Ingots
steps.description: Hammer out flaws from cooled ingots and shape bronze rivets

loopDescription: Work a shift at the Foundry Row furnace. Deliver ore, sort blackcoal, smelt timed batches, and hammer flawed ingots.
failureState: If the furnace heat drops too low or a batch is mistimed, the smelt fails and the ingots are lost.

name: Kilnwatch Primer

steps.name: Gather Materials
steps.description: Gather bead clay or glass sand from the kiln stores

steps.name: Fire Beads
steps.description: Load the kiln and fire beads, following the temperature curve

steps.name: Sort and String
steps.description: Sort fired beads by quality and string them into primer strands

loopDescription: The player works a shift at the bead kiln, gathering clay or sand, firing beads, sorting them by quality, and stringing them into primer strands.
failureState: If the kiln temperature is mismanaged, the beads crack into fragments and the firing step fails.

name: River Basket

steps.name: Cast the Basket
steps.description: Cast the fishing basket into the River Stoop and let it settle

steps.name: Haul and Sort
steps.description: Haul the basket back and sort the catch into edible and non-edible fish

steps.name: Cook on the Range
steps.description: Cook the edible fish on the Kitchen Range

loopDescription: The player casts a fishing basket into the River Stoop, waits, hauls it back, sorts the catch, and cooks the edible fish on the Kitchen Range.
failureState: If the basket overflows or the catch is spoiled, the haul is lost. If the fish burns on the range, no cooked fish is produced.
